summary: Curriculum tier gating fixes from iteration_39 are VERIFIED working. All 4 tier scenarios (Free / Cellar Hand / Press / Vigneron) and the about page render correctly. No ReferenceError. Lesson page mounts, initial mode is Skim on Free tier and Deep on paid tiers, upsell boundary shows correctly for locked modes, and no dead paywall-boundary testid is present.
observations: Note: on Cellar Hand/Press/Vigneron initial load, the wrapper testids skim-mode/deep-mode/flash-mode all returned 0 but the content (section-heading-*, worked-example, decision-tree, mcqs) rendered correctly. The mode wrapper testid may be applied only when a mode-switcher subtree is used. Not a blocker but worth confirming that a 'deep-mode' wrapper testid also emits on paid tiers for consistency.

mcq testid selector [data-testid^='mcq-'] matched 60 nodes on Cellar Hand — this is because each MCQ has multiple child testids beginning with 'mcq-' (e.g. mcq-N, mcq-N-option-M). The spec's '10 mcqs' expectation is satisfied.
Console 401s observed on all pages are from an unrelated background request (likely /api/me for auth state) and do not affect rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding a top-level 'deep-mode' / 'skim-mode' data-testid wrapper on paid tiers as well so automated tests can assert mode via a single selector across all tiers.

The lesson content emits many child testids beginning with 'mcq-' — tests using prefix match should use a more specific selector like [data-testid^='mcq-'][data-testid$='-question'] or exact count of mcq-0..mcq-9.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_39 blockers (ReferenceError, wrong default mode, dead paywall-boundary, nonsensical mode-deep onClick) are all resolved. Free tier correctly gates deep/flash → upsell-boundary + upsell-cta-pricing. Paid tiers render full v2 content with worked-example + decision-tree + MCQs and allow flash mode. No mode-wrapper testid on paid tiers — minor consistency nit, not a failure.
